snippet.title: holoVillage: Our Cozy Days Trailer
snippet.description:
■About holoVillage
#holoVillage is coming to Steam from holoIndie in late 2025.
Farm, fish, explore, craft, run a shop, dress up…
Enjoy a cozy slow life with your favorite Hololive members 🌲🏠
Supports multiplayer too! ✨

Stay tuned for more updates!

SteamStore：https://store.steampowered.com/app/3856280/
holoVillage Official X：https://x.com/holovillage_en
